source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Press "Del" when the hint shows up during POST. Check the information and see if SUT could boot into BIOS setup menu.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. POST information (include BIOS version and release date) should be readable and correct.
2. SUT should boot into BIOS setup menu successfully.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; correctly identifies pre-OS physical interaction.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED; adds hint, version/date, correct menu and return-to-boot evidence.
historical_reviews.round_02: NO due physical keyboard/BIOS visual step.

original_test_intent: Verify that the POST Delete-key hint works, opens BIOS Setup, and displays readable/correct BIOS version and release date.
original_method: Bind expected version/date and menu identity to the SUT, use an approved boot window and physical keyboard/display, have an engineer press Delete at the visible hint, capture the resulting Setup screen and exit safely to normal boot.
manual_activity: A human must press Delete in the transient pre-OS window and visually confirm the correct BIOS Setup screen and displayed version/date. SSH or inventory queries cannot prove the hotkey path.
required_inputs: Exact board/BIOS build and approved version/release-date reference
Expected Delete-key hint and Setup screen
Keyboard layout/connection and physical display path
Boot window and safe exit/recovery procedure
safety_requirements: Do not infer success from OS/BMC firmware inventory or normal boot.
Confirm no active workload before the controlled boot interruption.
Use the platform's shown hint/timing; do not automate blind key flooding.
Do not change BIOS settings while verifying entry.
Stop on wrong menu, unreadable data or inability to exit/recover; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare firmware baseline, expected values and visual evidence checklist.
Analyze supplied POST/Setup captures and correlate BMC/console/boot context.
Report evidence without claiming the key press, visual observation or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the boot window and operate the physical Delete key.
Observe/capture hint, correct Setup entry, BIOS version and release date.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct: ordinary SSH cannot inject or verify a pre-OS Delete hotkey and screen transition.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No software replacement; retain physical pre-OS key action and visual evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Delete key, hint timing, version/date, BIOS Setup criterion and 30/30-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: HUMAN PRE-OS INTERACTION WITH TRACEABLE VISUAL EVIDENCE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture a continuous timestamped sequence from POST hint through Delete press and Setup entry, including version/date and safe exit.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems with the documented Delete hotkey on the designated console.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC build, keyboard/display path and capture method.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner-supplied platform POST/hotkey and BIOS version specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds expected-value binding and continuous evidence without automating the manual core.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Remote KVM key injection is an override and may not represent a physical keyboard path unless approved.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve remote KVM as the console under test, but must document it. OS/BMC version checks remain supplementary.
expected_evidence: POST hint and physical keyboard/display setup
Timestamped visual evidence of Delete action and correct Setup screen
Readable matching version/date and safe return to boot

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, procedure and criteria consistently define Delete-key BIOS Setup entry and displayed information.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Intent is clear and manual; missing equipment/reference is readiness, not semantic blockage.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its complete visual/evidence improvements and MANUAL ONLY classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates agent capture analysis from engineer interaction and verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents firmware inventory from being accepted as proof that the Delete hotkey and Setup transition worked.
independent_technical_reasoning: The key timing, screen transition and visual data are the behavior under test and require an engineer at the pre-OS console; MANUAL ONLY is definitive.
